frames_manifest._comment: E12 observation set. Real LIBERO frames from the SAME source as bench/fixtures/observation.json (the HuggingFaceVLA/libero dataset through the datasets-server rows API), not re-rendered. They exist because docs/E12_corun/README.md §6.1 requires several materially different observations: with one observation per frame the expert's KV would be identical every frame and a stale-KV bug would be invisible, which would leave the fresh-KV check with no power and every E12 number ungated.
frames_manifest.task: put the white mug on the left plate and put the yellow and white mug on the right plate

variant_tokens.bf16_both: E7's rung exactly (casts + model.denoise_step@reduce-overhead, pg.embed_image@reduce-overhead+clone, pg.forward@max-autotune-no-cudagraphs)
variant_tokens.stock: shipping sample_actions timestep: torch.tensor(<float>, device) rebuilt every step
variant_tokens.hoist: the N timestep tensors built once and reused (corun.timestep_tensors); nothing else
variant_tokens.shipping_full: the whole frame through policy.predict_action_chunk (E7's `full` loop)
variant_tokens.stages: the whole frame as corun.prefix_stage + corun.expert_stage (same compiled callables)
variant_tokens.owngraph_expert: denoise_step compiled WITHOUT cudagraph trees (same Inductor kernels) and the N-step expert loop captured as ONE torch.cuda.CUDAGraph with its OWN pool
variant_tokens.kv_copy: each frame's KV / pad / noise copied into the expert graph's static input buffers ON THE EXPERT STREAM (counted in the expert stage time)
variant_tokens.prefix_first: per frame the host issues prefix(k) before expert(k-1)
variant_tokens.expert_first: per frame the host issues expert(k-1) before prefix(k)
variant_tokens.green_<p>_<e>:
prefix in a green-context partition of

SMs, expert in a disjoint one of ; each stage's graph CAPTURED inside its own green context (M0: a graph captured on the primary context is NOT confined when replayed on a green stream)
variant_tokens.hog_<rate>: in-process bandwidth hog (device copy graph) on the expert partition's stream

m0_graph_confinement: raw/m0_graph_confinement.json (bench/e12b_m0.py): a graph captured on the primary context is NOT confined when replayed on a green stream (0.99x at 4 SMs); captured inside the green context it is (3.24x). Every graph of this run was captured inside its own green context.

decisions.splits: 12/4 and 8/8 (required), 10/6, 6/10 (added because the confined compiled expert turned out SM-sensitive), 14/2; all granted as requested
decisions.config: graphs_both: the only configuration whose prefix can be confined (the rung's embed_image tree is recorded outside the partition)
decisions.hog: in-process copy graph captured inside the expert partition; 'max' = copies back to back, 'matched' = copies interleaved with torch.cuda._sleep bisected toward the fair expert's average demand (~63 GB/s); a small partition cannot drive DRAM hard, so in 12/4 and 14/2 max and matched coincide
